Read-only audit passed for all 102 gradient cases and NPZ archives.

Check Mac M3 Linux Ryzen 9950X
Cases / raw measurements 51 / 218 51 / 218
Real parameters per gradient 4–167 4–167
Worst full-gradient relative error 6.39e-9 6.39e-9
Worst individual block error 5.47e-7 1.73e-7
Native full-gradient peak RSS 40.0–54.0 MiB 42.9–56.9 MiB
Native/upstream exact-linear comparison* 1.01–4.86× 0.714–5.95×

*Ratios are upstream/native runtime. The Linux cylindrical coefficient case, N=2, L=2, 256 samples, one thread, makes native 1.40× slower than the exact upstream linear adjoint. This remains correctly separated from finite differences.

Verified hashes, array shapes, parameter counts, selected steps, per-block errors, thresholds, timing samples/medians, and RSS preservation through the report normalizer. Each platform has 28 full coordinate step sweeps and 23 directional step selections followed by complete coordinate checks. Fifteen coarse-step residuals exceed the final tolerance but remain correctly labelled diagnostics; all selected gradients pass.

No current dataset/report mismatch found. These measure fresh framework-neutral gradients, not cached-operator reuse, framework tracing, GPU derivatives, or very large full-coordinate gradients. No files changed or numerical benchmarks rerun.
